text:
Magnesium is added to dilute hydrochloric acid.
25cm3 of gas is given off in the first 30s of the reaction.
The experiment is repeated at a lower temperature. All other reaction conditions are the same.
Which volume of gas is produced in the first 30s of this reaction?
15cm3
25cm3
30cm3
50cm3
A
B
C
D
subject: Chemistry
